title.narrative: Sino-Norwegian Project on Hazardous Chemicals,SINOCHEM II

description.narrative: Through bilateral exchanges, policy dialogues and seminars, SINOCHEM II will contribute to a common understanding of challenges related to implementing the Stockholm Convention. The project further aims to provide direction for exploring a green and sustainable future management model for PFAS and their alternatives in China by engaging experts and industries in the dialogue. This second phase of SINOCHEM will continue to be jointly implemented by FECO, Ministry of Ecology and Environment in China, and Norwegian Environment Agency (NEA) under the Norwegian Ministry of Climate and Environment.
